source_instruction: i need a wall mounted mirror in the color d.
query: I was out walking my neighbor’s golden retriever earlier today, and we cut through that little community garden tucked between the laundromat and the old bakery on Oak Street. The sun hit the patch of giant sunflowers right at the edge of the path so perfectly that their petals looked like they were glowing bright enough to cast tiny gold flecks on the crushed gravel under our feet. The dog stopped dead in his tracks to sniff at a bumblebee that was bumbling slow and heavy from one zinnia to the next, and I stood there for a good five minutes just watching, not even checking my phone the whole time. It was the kind of tiny, unplanned nice moment that makes a random Tuesday feel way more special than it has any right to, honestly. I’m browsing the decorative mirrors section right now, and there’s a ceiling mounted one in that section, plus a small pack of heavy-duty adhesive hanging strips that pairs with it for under 180. I’ve heard option d is available when stock levels allow for it, too.
